details: President Donald Trump rejected Iran's latest peace proposal as "totally unacceptable" and "garbage," stating the ceasefire is "on life support." Iran's demands reportedly included war reparations, sovereignty over the Strait of Hormuz, and an end to sanctions. This diplomatic stalemate has caused Brent crude oil futures to rise above $104.50 a barrel due to concerns over the Strait of Hormuz remaining largely closed, escalating geopolitical uncertainty.
title: Trump Rejects Iran Peace Plan, Oil Prices Jump

details: The US Senate Banking Committee is scheduled to vote on the "CLARITY Act" on May 14, a landmark bill aiming to establish a comprehensive regulatory framework for cryptocurrencies. Key provisions include defining crypto tokens as securities or commodities and regulating stablecoin rewards. A compromise was reached allowing rewards on transaction-based activity but prohibiting them on idle stablecoin balances. The bill seeks to provide legal clarity for the burgeoning crypto industry.
title: US Senate Committee to Vote on Crypto Regulatory Bill
